title: QuestionAnswer
description: The answer to one question of an `interaction`, by its id: the labels chosen and the free answer, never the SDK's joined string.

questionId.description: The `id` of the question in the request's `interaction`.

selected.description: The labels chosen, exactly as the request gave them. Empty when only the free answer was given.

other.description: The free answer ("Other"), when there is one. Never blank.
